prs.summary: The pull request makes meta.Proceed() work in an aspect that overrides a compiler-synthesized record member, which previously failed with LAMA0651; the head commit 37a92204 is a merge of develop/2027.0 into the topic branch, and the branch carries nine commits and 110 changed files over base 36e12789. The new file Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework.Engine/Linking/SynthesizedRecordMemberBodyGenerator.cs declares the enum SynthesizedRecordMemberKind (None, EqualityContractGetter, Equals, GetHashCode, ToString, PrintMembers, Deconstruct) and a static generator that reproduces the body from the IMethodSymbol alone: typeof(T) for EqualityContract; a reference-equality short-circuit followed by either an EqualityContract comparison or base.Equals((Base?) other) and EqualityComparer<T>.Default comparisons for Equals; a hash combination with the multiplier -1521134295 inside an unchecked expression for GetHashCode; a StringBuilder local named builder for ToString; RuntimeHelpers.EnsureSufficientExecutionStack (only for a reference record without a record base) followed by Append calls for PrintMembers; and one assignment per out parameter for Deconstruct; the fields follow the order of GetMembers, include field-like events (GetFieldsToEmit with IsEventField), and an auto-property is read through the linker-materialized backing field when HasMaterializedBackingField is true and through the property otherwise. The new Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework.Engine/Linking/Substitution/SynthesizedRecordMemberSubstitution.cs is a SyntaxNodeSubstitution whose ReplacedNode is the record declaration and which returns the result, assigns it to the return variable, or emits it as a discard statement; Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework.Engine/Linking/LinkerAnalysisStep.SubstitutionGenerator.cs selects it at line 911 for a RecordDeclaration or RecordStructDeclaration root when GetMemberKind is not None, replacing the former throw of LAMA0651, and every other root, including a record member of kind None, still reaches the AssertionFailedException at line 920. For the non-inlined path, Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework.Engine/Linking/LinkerRecordHelper.cs renames GetNotSupportedImplMethod and GetNotSupportedImplProperty to GetOriginalImplMethod and GetOriginalImplProperty, emits the materialized body into the _Source member, keeps a NotSupportedException body (GetNotSupportedBody, whose message now names the record type) for a member whose kind is None, such as the set accessor of a synthesized property, and sorts both override-target lists in place with StructuralSymbolComparer.Default. Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework.Engine/Linking/LinkerAnalysisStep.InlineabilityAnalyzer.cs makes the generated ToString body non-inlineable through SynthesizedRecordMemberBodyGenerator.BodyDeclaresLocalVariable, and Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework.Engine/Linking/LinkerRewritingDriver.Methods.cs adds ModifierCategories.ReadOnly to the modifiers that GetSpecialImplMethod copies, so that the ToString_Source of a record struct is readonly (Tests/Aspects/Records/ToString_RecordStruct.t.cs). Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework.Engine/Linking/LinkerRewritingDriver.cs adds HasMaterializedBackingField(IPropertySymbol) and HasMaterializedBackingField(IEventSymbol), and Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework.Engine/Linking/LinkerAnalysisStep.cs adds VerifyRecordMemberMaterialization, which reports the new warning LAMA0652 (Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework.Engine/Linking/AspectLinkerDiagnosticDescriptors.cs, where LAMA0651 is removed) at a virtual or non-sealed override auto-property that a reachable materialized Equals or GetHashCode reads through the property rather than a materialized backing field. On the public API side, Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework/Code/MemberExtensions.cs adds CanBeDeclaredExplicitly(this IMember), which returns true for every explicitly declared member and otherwise false for a compiler-generated field, for an accessor whose containing member returns false, and for an implicitly declared record method that is either a single-parameter Equals whose parameter type is not the declaring record or an == or != operator; Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework/Eligibility/EligibilityExtensions.cs wraps it as MustBeDeclarableExplicitly with the message "must be a member that can be declared explicitly in source code", and Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework/Eligibility/EligibilityRuleFactory.cs uses it in OverrideMethodAdviceRule and OverrideFieldOrPropertyOrIndexerAdviceRule. Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework.Engine/AdviceImpl/Introduction/IntroduceMethodAdvice.cs reports the new error LAMA0552 (Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework.Engine/Advising/AdviceDiagnosticDescriptors.cs) when an introduction with OverrideStrategy.Override finds an existing method on the target type itself that cannot be declared explicitly. The tests add 38 aspect test sources (with 40 .t.cs and 4 .t.txt files) under Metalama.Framework/src/tests/Metalama.Framework.Tests.AspectTests/Tests/Aspects/Records/, of which CopyConstructor_Simple.t.cs and CopyConstructor_Derived.t.cs have no matching .cs source anywhere on the branch (both were added in commit 05b05411 without one), so the figure of 63 tests in the pull request body is not reproducible from the diff; they update the expected outputs of six Bug582* tests, of RecordAspectOrdering (eight LAMA0041 errors reduced to three, for Equals(object), == and !=), of Overrides/Properties/Record_Implicit (a LAMA0039 error replaced by a materialized EqualityContract getter), of three Overrides/Fields error tests and two Fabrics tests, and they add the unit test Metalama.Framework/src/tests/Metalama.Framework.Tests.UnitTests/CodeModel/CanBeDeclaredExplicitlyTests.cs. Its relevance is to union types. The C# 15 proposal dotnet/csharplang proposals/csharp-15.0/unions.md (fetched from the main branch on 2026-09-03) lowers a union declaration to a struct declaration, explicitly not a record struct, that carries the [Union] attribute, implements IUnion, has one public constructor per case type and a public object? Value { get; } auto-property; it states that user-declared members conflicting with generated members are an error and does not mention Equals, GetHashCode, ToString, operators or Deconstruct. The compiler-synthesized union members are therefore constructors and an auto-property, not the family this pull request materializes, so SynthesizedRecordMemberBodyGenerator is not directly reusable for unions; what the stable Roslyn 5.10 actually synthesizes, and whether INamedTypeSymbol.IsRecord is false for a union, must be verified against the shipped compiler (Metalama.Compiler is not cloned). The mechanism is record-gated in four places that a union story would have to extend: SynthesizedRecordMemberBodyGenerator.GetMemberKind returns None unless the containing type IsRecord (Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework.Engine/Linking/SynthesizedRecordMemberBodyGenerator.cs line 102); the substitution selection at line 911 of Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework.Engine/Linking/LinkerAnalysisStep.SubstitutionGenerator.cs matches only SyntaxKind.RecordDeclaration or RecordStructDeclaration, so an implicitly declared union member whose primary declaration syntax is a UnionDeclarationSyntax (kind UnionDeclaration per FACTS.md) would reach the AssertionFailedException at line 920 when an aspect calls meta.Proceed(); LinkerRecordHelper.GetSynthesizedMethodOverrideTargets and GetSynthesizedPropertyOverrideTargets (Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework.Engine/Linking/LinkerRecordHelper.cs lines 48 and 76) collect only members whose primary declaration syntax is a record declaration; and MemberExtensions.IsRecordMemberAddedUnconditionally (Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework/Code/MemberExtensions.cs line 87) returns false unless the declaring type IsRecord. Pre-existing record-kind switches outside this pull request that would each need a UnionDeclaration case are at Metalama.Framework/src/Metalama.Framework.Engine/Linking/LinkerSyntaxHandler.cs lines 104-105, LinkerRewritingDriver.cs line 324, LinkerAnalysisStep.SemanticBodyAnalyzer.cs lines 244 and 418, LinkerAnalysisStep.AspectReferenceCollector.cs line 203, Inlining/ImplicitLastOverrideReferenceInliner.cs line 69, LinkerInjectionStep.Rewriter.cs lines 641-642, LinkerLateTransformationRegistry.cs lines 149-152 and 190-191, and Linking/SymbolExtensions.cs lines 29-30. The reusable parts are the design patterns: a SyntaxNodeSubstitution whose ReplacedNode is the type declaration and whose body is generated from the symbol, the (Statements, Result) body-generator contract with return, assign and discard handling, the BodyDeclaresLocalVariable non-inlineability hook, the GetOriginalImplMethod _Source emission, and CanBeDeclaredExplicitly, whose IsRecordMemberAddedUnconditionally would need a union analog for the generated Value property and case constructors.
prs.notes_for_user_stories: Do not write a story for meta.Proceed() on compiler-synthesized record members, for a public "can this member be declared in source" helper, or for deterministic ordering of synthesized record override targets: #1879 implements all three (SynthesizedRecordMemberBodyGenerator, MemberExtensions.CanBeDeclaredExplicitly with EligibilityExtensions.MustBeDeclarableExplicitly, and StructuralSymbolComparer sorting in LinkerRecordHelper). Diagnostic identifiers LAMA0552 (advice error) and LAMA0652 (linker warning) are taken and LAMA0651 is removed, so a new story must not allocate or reuse those numbers. The eligibility message changed to "must be a member that can be declared explicitly in source code", which altered the expected outputs of RecordAspectOrdering, Record_Implicit, BackingField_Error, BackingFieldAdvice_Error, PrimaryConstructorParameter_Error and the two Target_Record*_TypeFabricAddAdvice_Implicit tests; a story that touches eligibility messages or these tests should be based on this branch. A union story must not assume the record mechanism applies as is: the C# 15 proposal lowers a union to a plain struct with [Union], an IUnion implementation, a Value auto-property and one constructor per case type, with no Equals, GetHashCode or ToString synthesis mentioned, and every record gate in the linker and in CanBeDeclaredExplicitly is keyed on IsRecord or on RecordDeclaration/RecordStructDeclaration; the story should say "extend the #1879 substitution pattern and CanBeDeclaredExplicitly for union members" rather than "add support for synthesized members", and should state that the shipped Roslyn 5.10 behaviour for unions is unverified. The copy constructor is explicitly deferred by #1879 to its own issue, so a story about overriding record copy constructors does not duplicate it, but it must reference the three MustNotBeRecordCopyConstructor rules in EligibilityRuleFactory.cs and should add real tests, because the CopyConstructor_Simple.t.cs and CopyConstructor_Derived.t.cs files in #1879 have no .cs source and execute nothing. The reviewer's latest request on #1879 (materialized bodies must read the _Source layer of an overridden property, with tests) is still pending on the pull request itself and has no answering commit; do not create a separate story for it unless the pull request merges without it. The pull request is open with CHANGES_REQUESTED and no CI result on GitHub, so a story that depends on CanBeDeclaredExplicitly or on LAMA0552/LAMA0652 should state the dependency on #1879 merging.
